0.65 anchors: brief detention, released, remedies functioning.

This is a mixed regime: national hostile layer with tier-1-ish document exposure at border, division-level relative protection. Score likely mid — around 0.50-0.60.

Rule of law: litigation functioning, remedies partially work (governor vetoes, state justice dept joining challenge). Positive.

Score: 0.53.
